author: CuuurlyFries
quote:
The video game equivalent of Joker 2.
Blatant bait and switch from a game of freedom, creativity and fun in GTA5 to being a simp for a fat chick, doing her chores for her (seriously, who waited 13 years for a game just to go shopping, paint walls and fix plumbing???) and then have her cheat on you ending with a kid that isn’t even yours!
Countless bugs, can’t shoot indoors, can’t commit grand theft auto in a game called grand theft auto and when shooting someone, they just run at you and instantly kill you with one punch.
The only thing grand theft auto six has in common with the other GTA games is the logo.
This is a massive middle finger to video game players everywhere that paid £100 for this half baked, woke, boring, man-hating one-sided romance game developed by a DEI hired team that hates gamers.
And 100% positive reviews with no criticisms from critics stinks of paid-off reviews and political bias.

0/10  
Would not recommend.
Going back to GTA5 and enjoying that instead.
Rockstar is done.
